source-owned actual public accepted Double Colorless Energy action and native target dispatch exact root linkage

owner public Stadium after settled DCE, if observable in sidecar
source attack and next opposing owner-root after DCE within original cap, counted as zero when absent
all eight status and source-specific abort/censor records

deal or seat or turn diverged
no exactly one owner Pokemon with DCE multiset count +1
target geometry differs from physical Pokemon energy delta
